verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own docs repeatedly claim the app 'works perfectly offline' and even when the connection is terrible, suggesting core reading/composing functionality persists without a network. However, there is no explicit documentation of offline search behavior or how changes (sent drafts, read/archive actions) reconcile once reconnected, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of offline sync reliability. missing for 10: explicit description of offline search indexing, detail on conflict resolution/sync-on-reconnect mechanics, and third-party verification of offline behavior.
